meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 把 Microsoft Teams 适配器复制进项目并注册，安装 @chat-adapter/teams 依赖，构建并跑注册测试；随后引导你创建 Teams 机器人、把凭据写进 .env、给出安装链接并完成接线。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 支持 Microsoft Teams，或提到“Teams 频道”时触发。前提是有能创建 Entra 应用的 Microsoft 365 账号，以及指向本机 3000 端口的 HTTPS 隧道。

say.text: 帮我把 Teams 频道接进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 帮我建一个叫 NanoClaw 的机器人
say.note: 会注册应用、生成密钥并返回安装链接

say.text: 把助手接到我的 Teams 账号上
say.note: 接线后助手会主动先给你发消息

howto.what_en: Copies the Microsoft Teams adapter into the project, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, builds and runs the registration test; then helps create the bot, store credentials in .env, and get an install link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want NanoClaw to support Microsoft Teams, or mention a "Teams channel". Needs a Microsoft 365 account able to create Entra apps, and an HTTPS tunnel to local port 3000.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams support to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs the test

say_en.text: Create a Teams bot named NanoClaw for me
say_en.note: Registers the app and bot, returns an install link

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account
say_en.note: The assistant then messages you first
